summary: Tested Commissions module backend (17 pytest cases) and frontend UI (admin unlock, view switcher, filters, modal create+save, persistence, logout). All backend assertions and all critical frontend flows pass against preview URL. Deleted test artifacts. One minor design issue: date inputs use native browser picker instead of shadcn Calendar.

design_issues.screen: Commissions filter panel & CommissionModal deadline field
issues: Date fields render the native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere in the app — inconsistent UX.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace native <input type='date'> with shadcn Calendar/Popover for f-deadline and filter date_from/date_to to match design system.
(Optional) Add a GET /api/commissions/{id} endpoint — currently single-item retrieval relies on filtering the list response.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses bare except (line ~115) in verify_token — replace with `except jwt.PyJWTError` for clarity (functional, but lint-style).
_optional_auth and verify_token duplicate JWT decode logic; consider extracting helper to keep auth single-sourced.

Commissions PUT replaces entire document via Commission(**item); clients sending a partial payload will reset unspecified fields to model defaults (e.g., status defaults to 'Requested', payments to []). Consider a PATCH or merge with existing record before replace.
create_commission/update_commission do not re-derive payment_status when client sends an explicit value — by design per spec, but worth documenting.
Frontend Commissions.jsx is a large single file mixing 4 view layouts + filters + admin modal. Consider splitting Kanban/List/Timeline/Gallery sub-components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed commissions and clean up in fixtures/finally blocks. UI test created TEST_UI_Commission and was cleaned up after the run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_commissions.py covers auth, visibility gating, CRUD, payment_status derivation, filters (status/platform/type/artist regex/usage_rights/price/date/visibility), and stats. All pass. Existing seeded public commission 'Ref Sheet' (KaeArt, Twitter, Full Body, $200 budget, $100 partial) remains in DB — used by stats/list assertions only loosely. Frontend testids: commissions-page, nav-commissions, stats-row, view-switcher, view-{kanban|list|timeline|gallery}, toggle-filters, filters-panel, clear-filters, admin-unlock-btn, admin-password-input, admin-login-submit, admin-logout-btn, new-commission-btn, commission-modal, vis-{public|admin|debut}, f-title/f-artist-name/f-budget/etc, commission-save-btn. NOTE: data-testid='row-' prefix matches edit/delete row buttons too (row-edit-, row-delete-) — use a more specific selector like `[data-testid^='row-']:not([data-testid*='-edit-']):not([data-testid*='-delete-'])` or testid 'row-card-' if counting actual rows.
